messages:
emily-sec: quick question — for SOC2 evidence we need to show KMS usage + rotation events across AWS/GCP/Azure. who can help map the queries?
kevin-sre: I can start. for AWS, CloudTrail ManagementEvents + KMSDataEvents. Filter on EventName: Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/RotateKey
samir-ops: also capture ReEncrypt, CreateGrant, DisableKey, EnableKey, and ScheduleKeyDeletion events
emily-sec: good. do we have an example CloudTrail event we can show as evidence?
kevin-sre: here's a snippet we usually include:
```
{ \"eventTime\": \"2024-07-11T12:34:56Z\", \"eventName\": \"GenerateDataKey\", \"userIdentity\": { \"arn\": \"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/deploy-bot\" }, \"requestParameters\": { \"encryptionContext\": { \"env\": \"prod\", \"service\": \"inference\" }, \"keyId\": \"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234\" } }
```
ruth-privacy: for evidence chain we need to show mapping from principal -> role -> request. include assume-role ARNs and session context (sourceIp, userAgent)
samir-ops: for GCP use Audit Logs: protoPayload.methodName = \"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Encrypt\" or Decrypt. sample filter:
```
resource.type=\"kms_key\" protoPayload.methodName:\"KeyManagementService.Encrypt\" AND timestamp>\"2024-01-01T00:00:00Z\"
```
kevin-sre: Azure: enable DiagnosticSettings on Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults to send AuditEvent to Log Analytics + StorageAccount. then query with Kusto: `AzureDiagnostics | where OperationName == \"Encrypt\" or OperationName == \"Decrypt\"`
emily-sec: rotation evidence — do we need the rotation schedule OR the key versions created? auditors ask for rotation timestamps.
ruth-privacy: prefer both. show rotation policy (if auto-rotate enabled) and list of key versions with creation timestamps. For AWS KMS, include CreateKey and RotateKey events plus a DescribeKey snapshot saved at time of evidence export.
samir-ops: also capture envelope encryption metadata from app logs — we should log DEK reference (key id or version) but never plaintext. example app log line: `DEK=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234, op=encrypt, bytes=1024, trace=tx-7b9`
kevin-sre: sampling plan suggestion: provide 5 sample Encrypt/Decrypt events per customer-managed key per quarter + a full export for the requested 90-day window. auditors usually accept samples but want the extraction queries and manifest.
emily-sec: also need proof of retention/immutable storage for logs (s3 bucket lock / GCS retention / Azure immutability). can we add that to the bundle?
samir-ops: yes — include bucket policy screenshots + retention settings output. for AWS: `aws s3api get-bucket-versioning` + `get-bucket-lifecycle-configuration` and `get-bucket-lock` (if used)
kevin-sre: I'll assemble a bundle: CloudTrail export (management + data events), GCP logs export (BigQuery/gcs), Azure diagnostics export, app log samples, DescribeKey/KeyRing snapshots, and a manifest.md that explains queries and redactions. manifest will include commands used.
ruth-privacy: redact PII and raw ARNs unless the audit explicitly asks for full ARNs. annotate every redaction in the manifest with the reason.
audit-bot: Incident note created: INC-2024-1635 — evidence bundle requested by compliance (owner: kevin-sre)
emily-sec: thanks. kevin, can you post the manifest and the exact extraction queries in this thread when done?
kevin-sre: will do by EOD. :thumbsup:
